BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing counties to have a lien againstproperties that were levied for storm water control facilities; andamending RCW 36.89.090.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 36.89.090 and 1991 c 36 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The county shall have a lien for delinquent ((service)) charges,including interest, penalties, and costs of foreclosure thereon,against any property against which they were levied for ((storm watercontrol facilities)) the purposes authorized by this chapter, whichlien shall be superior to all other liens and encumbrances exceptgeneral taxes and local and special assessments. Such lien shall beeffective upon the charges becoming delinquent and shall be enforcedand foreclosed in the same manner as provided for sewerage liens ofcities and towns by RCW 35.67.200 through 35.67.290((: PROVIDED,That)). However, a county may, by resolution or ordinance, adopt allor any part of the alternative interest rate, lien, and foreclosure p. 1 SHB 2656procedures as set forth in RCW 36.89.092 through 36.89.094 or ((byRCW)) 36.94.150 or chapters 84.56, 84.60, and 84.64 RCW.
